blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Cagayan de Oro Rep. Loran Suan has denied calling for a resolution that would urge a shoot-to-kill order against Senator Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa should he fail to properly surrender to authorities, saying such claims were fabricated. In a statement on Monday, Suan said he had neither threatened to call a House committee hearing nor proposed a resolution urging authorities to kill the senator if he failed to surrender in connection with an arrest warrant issued by the International Criminal Court (ICC). “As a lawyer and public servant, I believe firmly in due process and the rule of law,” […]...
